title: When Hypothesis Agents May Act Only Through Papers: A Protocol for Joint MCP-Hypothesis Benchmarks
summary: K SC Paper2Agent showed that a wrapped paper can outperform repository-browsing agents on tutorial and novel method queries (Miao et al., 2026). Co-Scientist, the AI Scientist and the Virtual Lab showed that multi-agent systems can propose hypotheses that sometimes survive experiment or review (Gottweis et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2024; Lu et al., 2026; Swanson et al., 2025). These results are not yet commensurate. Volume I called the comparison a category error and asked for a joint evaluation in which a hypothesis agent may act only through paper MCPs (Mamun, 2026a).
